Observed Behaviour: A clean dedicated main checkout first reconciles itself with origin/main, then builds once, delta-checks and canaries the exact candidate/baseline by SHA-256, transactionally promotes DB+history+both SHA-bound reports with rollback, creates an allowlisted local commit with repository hooks disabled, optionally pushes without force, and leaves mode-0600 receipts. A behind clone fast-forwards only and reexecutes fetched orchestration under the inherited lock; one verified unpushed data commit has a separately bound retry proof. Repository templates remain disabled; installed host migration is an explicit owner-approved operation.

Edge Cases: Concurrent schedule; upstream timeout/rate limit; fetch failure; remote advance/rewind/divergence; dirty-after-fetch race; arbitrary or verified local-ahead history; allowed-path race; malicious repository hooks; partial four-artifact promotion; commit/push failure; stale/future/corrupt DB; dry-run masking real failure; redirecting health endpoint.

Feature Name: Free-first registry and community evidence layer
User Story: As an EV driver I get a Spain-wide registry of ONLY free chargers with an honest verification ladder, and I can feed the ecosystem back: check-ins (did charging actually work?), photos, and suggested new points.
Observed Behaviour: GET /api/free-registry serves only rows with explicit free evidence (is_free or price_min==0; unknown price is never free) plus a free_verification ladder (live > community > corroborated > reported), community stats, and accepted suggestions as unmerged candidates. POST /api/community/checkin|photo|station are rate-limited (VOLTA_COMMUNITY_WRITE_RPM), daily-capped per pseudonymous client, optionally token-gated; photos are magic-byte validated (JPEG/PNG/WebP) and size-capped; moderation over HTTP is disabled unless VOLTA_ADMIN_TOKEN is set. The DGT NAP DATEX II adapter (CC BY, no registration) adds corroboration-only official rows and operator-app handoff links; the Mapa REVE external client is prepared but inactive until the owner obtains an x-api-key.
Inferred Intended Behaviour: Community evidence is its own tier: it may annotate or DOWNGRADE a decision (repeated recent failures drop go to check) but never upgrades one and never sets verification.live_verified. Corroboration raises free-claim confidence only. User content (community.db, photos) stays out of git.
Validation Rules: free_row() admits only explicit free evidence; check-ins/photos require a known station id (404 otherwise; new points go through /station suggestions); suggestions must fall inside the Spain envelope and land as pending, never on the map before moderation; client identity is a salted hash, never the raw IP; NAP parse fails closed if the site population shrinks below 5000; REVE tariffs count as free only when every published price component is 0.
Edge Cases: Empty community DB (no-op enrichment); daily caps reached (429); oversized/unsupported photo (413/415); moderation without admin token (403); community failure streak followed by a success (caution clears); NAP sites without coordinates are skipped; REVE key absent (client exits inactive).
